name: Pahalgam Massacre (April 2025)
description: Five TRF gunmen attacked tourists at Baisaran meadow, Pahalgam. 26 killed in deadliest civilian attack since 26/11. Direct trigger for Operation Sindoor.

attack_details.perpetrators: 5 TRF (The Resistance Front) gunmen — LeT proxy
attack_details.method: Automatic weapons; segregated victims by religion (asked names/prayers); shot non-Muslims
attack_details.victims: Tourists from various Indian states; some international tourists

perpetrators.trf_claim: The Resistance Front claimed responsibility — LeT proxy for deniability
perpetrators.fate: All 5 gunmen killed in subsequent operations

strategic_impact.timing: JD Vance visiting India; Modi in Saudi Arabia
strategic_impact.indian_response: Indus Waters Treaty suspended (next day); Operation Sindoor (May 7)

film_relevance.part_4: Opening tragedy; Sindoor catalyst; emotional stakes
film_relevance.thematic: TRF 'white-collar terror' — educated recruits vs traditional militants
